input_contract: completed chronological bars; no unfinished or future bar
output_contract: inspectable evidence card; committee and risk remain authoritative

definition.scope: Bounded local model; not the complete original school. Data availability and entry conditions are checked separately.
definition.scope_ar: نموذج محلي محدد القواعد؛ لا يمثل المدرسة الأصلية بكاملها. يجري فحص توفر البيانات وشروط الدخول بشكل منفصل.
rules: Correlation at least 0.7; one asset sweeps its prior 20-bar boundary and returns while its declared partner does not sweep.
rules_ar: ارتباط لا يقل عن 0.7؛ يسحب أصل حد عشرين شمعة ويعود داخله دون أن يسحب الأصل المقابل حده.

contract.promotion_policy: versioned code change plus tests; never automatic self-modification
contract.price_plan: closed-bar entry zone +/- 0.15 ATR; structural stop buffered 0.1 ATR; default 2R or explicit model target
contract.portfolio_authority: independent shared daily risk; no agent may alter limits

theory_scope_ar: نموذج محلي محدد القواعد، وليس المدرسة كاملة: اختلاف نطاق أصلين: نموذج محلي
rules_python:
def smt(b,c):
    pairs=aligned(b,c)
    if pairs is None:return wait(b,"aligned declared MT5 partner required",missing=True)
    own=[p[0] for p in pairs];partner=[p[1] for p in pairs]
    x,y=own[-1],partner[-1]
    lo=min(z["low"] for z in own[-21:-1]);hi=max(z["high"] for z in own[-21:-1])
    plo=min(z["low"] for z in partner[-21:-1]);phi=max(z["high"] for z in partner[-21:-1])
    corr=correlation(pairs)
    bull=corr>=.7 and x["low"]<lo<x["close"] and y["low"]>=plo and x["close"]>own[-2]["close"]
    bear=corr>=.7 and x["high"]>hi>x["close"] and y["high"]<=phi and x["close"]<own[-2]["close"]
    return signal(b,bull,bear,x["low"],x["high"],{"partner": c["partner_symbol"],"correlation": corr,"low": lo,"high": hi})
execution_note: Implemented rules still require committee, quote, risk and broker approval; this is not a profitability certificate.
